$comment: THE ONE REGISTRY for /test/interface-kit. Read by the page (TS import) and by scripts/capture-interface-kit.mjs (readFileSync) and mirrored into the ship's armada.toml [types]. Two readers, one record: a direction cannot be shot that the page cannot draw. TYPE IDS ARE LETTERS ONLY - the armada's filename grammar accepts only letters before the first dash, so a digit in the id silently falls to its unknown-shape branch (lane empty, draw 0) and every downstream tool reads a different file than it wrote. ⚠ ADR-092 STAGE 1 (2026-09-06) ABSORBED SEVEN OF THE NINE KNOBS into production - grid, line, track, weight, case, accent, material are what ships now - so they and their directions are gone from this registry, and the lab compares the two levers that are still open questions: the housing lip and how a station marks selection.

$measured.scope: the casefile panel (.fl-case) against each reference's whole page

trackingConcentration.note: share of text nodes on the single most-used rung - the number that actually reads

boldShare.note: share of text nodes above weight 500

structureLines.note: nodes drawing a structural rule, and how many hues they use
structureLines.proof: 20 lines, 2 hues (dawn .12/.28 after ADR-089, plus gold on the row glyphs and station diamonds)

$measured.finding: The gap is NOT that the house draws the wrong lines - ADR-089 already put the casefile's structure on dawn, and the house is stricter than both references on radius. The gap is (a) the accent is spent on an order of magnitude more objects, (b) no tracking rung dominates, so the mono chrome has no base register to depart from, (c) a quarter of the text is bold where the references keep bold under two per cent, and (d) the references draw SEVEN TIMES more structure lines than we do, all identical - they are ruled sheets, and a panel edge landing on a page rule is what makes a panel look seated.

lip.label: Housing lip
lip.note: gold = the machined edge ADR-089 shipped, the one sanctioned gold line. dawn = the console's own ruling applied to the housing, which makes the panel software drawn on the frame's screen rather than a device set into it.

tab.label: Station
tab.note: fill = ADR-089 U4's inverse video, what ships. line = no fill, a 1px accent line on the open box's bottom edge. outline = an accent border, no fill, ink label.

directions.name: House
directions.question: does the panel recomposed at house values read as the shipped one? (the control; after stage 1, house values ARE the composite the owner approved)
directions.shape: the control, recomposed from the production leaves

directions.name: Station line
directions.question: does a 1px line carry selection without a fill?
directions.shape: the open station is underlined, not filled

directions.name: Station outline
directions.question: does an outline carry selection without a fill?
directions.shape: the open station takes a gold border and keeps its ink

directions.name: Lip dawn
directions.question: is the housing a device set into the frame, or software drawn on its screen? The one gold line the composite kept, asked the other way round.
directions.shape: the housing's lip in the frame's own dawn; everything else as shipped

wave.note: 4 directions x 3 viewports x 2 themes = 24 candidates, plus 6 control stills shot from mount=shipped. 1920x1247 is the owner's own window; 1280x720 is the binding one. Wave 01 (2026-09-05) ran 10 directions; seven were absorbed by ADR-092 stage 1.

$after.when: 2026-09-06, the same probe (mechanical.mjs --scope .fl-case), 1440x900, dark, row 01, after ADR-092 stage 1
$after.contrastMisses: 5 in dark (ANALYSIS.md defect 9, chrome ink at 3.19-3.41:1), 1 in light (.fl-desig 3.96:1)
$after.note: From 200 accent objects to 8 marks; from 27 per cent bold to none; from 7 rungs with 26 per cent on the top to 4 with 48 per cent on the base rung .08em. The references ran 50-98 per cent.
